posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
McBehrer:

What if she has to use turmoil on EVERY deck? Then have AA kill her.

Turmoil on every deck has merit, but Handelabra said a long time back that every variant was unlockable through reasonable gameplay, meaning that you would never have to take an action that was counterproductive towards winning a game.  (Now, we frequently take counterproductive actions to reach game states necessary to unlock characters, but the unlock requirements themselves don't require self-sabotage)

 

It's possible that that policy has changed of course, but I rather doubt it.

(Now, we frequently take counterproductive actions to reach game states necessary to unlock characters, but the unlock requirements themselves don’t require self-sabotage) It’s possible that that policy has changed of course, but I rather doubt it.

Wouldn’t not playing bounties with Chrono Ranger generally be considered fairly counterproductive towards winning the game? And after thinking about it, couldn’t the same also be said about not playing any equipment cards with Haka?

Not doing something productive is different from doing something counterproductive. In my unlock of CR I didn’t do anything special while playing other than choosing who would deal the finishing blow more carefully than usual, and I got the unlock because in this particular game I had no reason to play bounties on other targets. Haka might never draw his equipment, or always a better card to play. But deliberately incapping one of your own heroes with damage from another hero is not a choice that a player who isn’t looking for the unlock would make. It is therefore impossible to discover the unlock on accident.
